# TweackTech

> TweackTech is a tech learning platform and talent hub founded by Meyor Dari. Students learn practical tech skills through detailed lessons, runnable code examples, module quizzes, certificates and a developer talent hub.

## Learn

- [Courses](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/courses): the full catalogue of beginner, intermediate and advanced tech courses.
- [Student stories](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/testimonials): testimonies from learners who completed courses.
- [Blog](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/blog): guides and career articles for developers.

## Careers

- [Talent Hub](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/talent): developer profiles and skills.
- [Jobs](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/jobs): open developer roles.
- [Mentors](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/mentors): verified tech mentors.

## About

- [About us](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/about): who we are and what we teach.
- [Contact](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/contact): get in touch with the team.
- [FAQ](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/faq): answers to common questions.
- [Support](https://tweacktech.vercel.app/support): help centre and tickets.
